objective: Test whether on-policy distillation can transfer a stronger language-model teacher's target-label-free expert-routing behaviour into a smaller student without replacing the numerical catalyst predictors.
evidence_boundary: Shadow-only method development. Existing catalyst programme outcomes may evaluate development behaviour but may not establish prospective discovery or promotion. A new programme with sealed outcomes is required for confirmation.

authority_boundary.llm_router: advisory selection among frozen experts and predict/rank/abstain actions
authority_boundary.deterministic_decoder: validates the router decision and fails closed to abstain
authority_boundary.operator: retains authority to promote or execute any recommendation

training_contract.method: student on-policy rollout followed by teacher token-distribution supervision
training_contract.tokenizer: teacher and student tokenization fingerprints must match exactly
training_contract.teacher_advantage: must be demonstrated on held-out routing prompts before scientific evaluation

scientific_gate.split: leave-one-programme-out during development, then one sealed external programme

promotion_rule: Do not replace the existing router or any numerical expert unless both the implementation gate and sealed scientific gate pass.
